basis: First Solar’s Q3 results release was the earliest qualifying disclosure found. Its consolidated statements of operations report net sales of $583,504,000 for the three months ended September 30, 2021, against $927,565,000 for the same quarter of 2020. That is a 37.09% decline, below the $881,186,750 cutoff. Both figures come from the same GAAP table, which presents the prior-year comparative after the 2021 business sales.

coverage.detail: February 25, 2021. The initial 2021 outlook put full-year net sales at $2.85 billion to $3.0 billion. It gave no separate Q3 sales range.

April 29. The Q1 release raised the full-year sales ceiling to $3.025 billion. It recorded the $151 million gain on the U.S. project development and North American operations and maintenance business sales separately from net sales.
April 29 earnings presentation. The sales guidance on slide 9 covers full-year 2021. The Q1 call’s discussion of module and systems revenue also provided no consolidated Q3 ceiling.

July 29. The Q2 release raised full-year net sales guidance to $2.875 billion–$3.1 billion. Subtracting reported first-half net sales of $1,432,554,000 implies $1,442,446,000–$1,667,446,000 for Q3 and Q4 combined. That arithmetic leaves Q3 sales undetermined.
July 29 earnings presentation. The Q3-to-date figure of 2.0 GW measured net bookings. First Solar explained that shipment volumes do not directly determine recognized revenue.

July 29 public call, preserved in a third-party transcript. Management expected most remaining systems-segment revenue and gross margin in Q4. That timing remark covered one segment and gave no upper bound for consolidated Q3 sales.

Investor overview listed by First Solar IR on August 16. The deck dates its financial guidance to July 29 and repeats the full-year range. Its quarterly income statement ends at Q2, and its Q3 figure measures bookings in GW.

October 21. First Solar announced the November 4 reporting date and call time without releasing preliminary revenue. The intervening filing inventory and searches for issuer updates, presentations and public management remarks yielded no earlier qualifying Q3 figure.

November 4. First Solar’s original wire release identifies the company as the source and timestamps public distribution at 4:05 p.m. ET. The SEC exhibit linked above supplies the exact quarterly figures in thousands of dollars.

publication_date_evidence: The SEC EX-99.1 release is datelined November 4, 2021, and identifies the reporting period as the third quarter ended September 30. The issuer’s wire timestamp independently confirms publication on November 4 at 4:05 p.m. ET, before the November 5 Form 10-Q filing.
